segments.reason: Probe first on every idea, sure_note and hint ladder on each probe, show-me exits on the second-level traps. Keys are not telegraphed. No fast lane.

Patched: show-me exits added to the first-level traps (pap_t5a, fol_t4a, side_t5, common_t3, iodine_t3, niftp_t6a, vig_t6, ftest_t1a). Second-level traps (pap_t5b, fol_t4b, side_t6, niftp_t6b, vig_t4, iodine_partial) are retry-only.

Predict-observe-explain for follicular spread, a paired contrast, and a lateral-neck case with a retest. Route is derived from invasion, so the path separates the reversed-route model from the right one.
Bethesda-to-action and extent-of-surgery ladder, each step probed in two forms with a worked case and a skip. Clean category-to-action feedback.

Patched: hints on every probe and show-me on the first-level traps. Telegraphing remains: the key is the longest option in u1, u3 and u5, and the only non-thyroxine option in u2. u5 option 3 is weak. Second-level traps u1_t2 to u6_t2 are retry-only.
Faded worked example that ends in cold probes, with traps re-tested across the ladder (marker, antibodies, scan, staging age). S6.w1 packs four steps into three messages, which strains load.
Clinical moments (day one, singer, six-hour haematoma, airway, pairs, marker). Each symptom is tied to its nerve; the cause-first ordering is taught and tested.

Patched to new stems with no hints, which gives real cold evidence. But the keys telegraph: k3 is the odd-one-out and its key text ('lobectomy alone is enough') contradicts its feedback ('both acceptable'); k1, k2, k4 and k5 keys are the longest or the only qualified option. h1 and h5 keys are also longer or glossed.

best_parts: node S2.pap_ask and S2.pap_t5a: the architecture-versus-nuclei refutation with a show-me exit that gives the nuclear rule, then a re-test in S2.side_ask
node S3.fol_predict and S3.fol_explain: predict-then-show route from vessel invasion; the follicular route is derived, not memorised
node S7.neck and S7.neck_show: cause-first ordering with a flat-neck contrast on S7.airway, so the learner must separate the two haematoma cases
node S6.fade2: antibody-qualifier probe with an undetectable-value trap and a show-me that names the assay problem
node S4.f3 and S4.x3: name-to-action pairing with a V-versus-IV contrast and a short explanation that puts category and action side by side
flaws: node S8.k3: the key 'Lobectomy alone is enough for this low-risk tumour' is the only option without 'total thyroidectomy', so it is found by elimination; the key text also contradicts its own feedback ('lobectomy or total thyroidectomy are both acceptable'). Rewrite the key as 'either lobectomy or total thyroidectomy' and give the traps the same shape.
node S8.k5 and S8.k1: the key is the only option with a qualifier ('no antibodies, clean ultrasound'; 'primary maybe occult') and is the longest, so form gives it away.
node S8.k2: the key is the only option with a second clause ('and surgery for pressure symptoms'); the other three are single clauses.
node S5.u2: the key is the only non-thyroxine option, so the two thyroxine distractors can be eliminated by form. Give the distractors a second non-thyroxine step.
nodes S5.u1 and S5.u3: the key is the longest option and carries a 'because' clause; the traps are shorter.
node S5.u5_t2 ('Only if the tumour is follicular'): weakly tempting; a student who knows the risk rule rejects it at once, so it is close to dominated.

nodes S5.u1_t2 to S5.u6_t2, S2.pap_t5b, S2.fol_t4b, S2.side_t6, S2.niftp_t6b, S2.vig_t4 and S2.iodine_partial: feedback is retry-only, so a learner who holds the belief has no second explanation on that path.
node S6.w1: four steps are packed into three messages, and step 3 carries two results; split it so one step sits in each message.

report (report.json, sim/misconceived.report.json): all ten objectives are 'shaky' even though all six cold probes were right and every trap held on re-test. The objective status ignores recovery credit, so the report does not say which objectives are solid.
report: per-trap texts follow one template ('Under pressure the X can return'), so the fell_recovered lines read the same across traps and do not say which wrong model to drop first.
voice: 'That choice is not right.' opens most wrong-answer feedback, so tone goes flat by the middle of S2 (noted in sim/misconceived.md).
merge_ideas: S8 cold check built on S5.u4's split-answer format (two halves, each with its own qualifier), so no option is found by length or position
second-level trap feedback borrows S2.pap_ask_show's pattern (show-me that names the rule), so every trap path has a second explanation
objective status in the report credits re-test recovery: a fell_recovered trap that holds on re-test lifts its objective from shaky to secure
